a first-person detective stealth video game
Shadows of Doubt is an open world detective investigation game
takes place in an alternate history that diverges from the real world in the year 1610
most people live and work in cramped, smog-shrouded cities isolated by the toxic water
The player can complete a murder case by submitting a case resolution form to the local city hall
The player's overarching goal is to increase their social credit score by solving murder cases
If the player accuses the wrong citizen, they will be fined and the real murderer will continue killing
critiquing its repetitive elements and bugs
